purpose: Call attention to something the listener can also recognize.
keywords: Plain sentence + じゃない / じゃないか
Look, you can see a rainbow!
See, you can do it easily this way.
I told you the same thing yesterday, remember?
formation: Plain sentence + じゃない / じゃないか
restrictions: Intonation and context distinguish this from an ordinary negative.
mistake: きれいじゃない can mean either “not pretty” or “isn’t it pretty?”; make context clear.
